# Signet7

> A cryptographic seal on the letter. Two facts. You keep the file.

Akasha is the name on the front door. The company is Signet7.

- Home: https://signet7.io/
- Check an email: https://verify.signet7.io/email/verify
- Product: https://signet7.io/product
- FAQ: https://signet7.io/faq
- Docs: https://signet7.io/docs
- Team: https://signet7.io/about
- Privacy: https://signet7.io/privacy
- What is live: https://signet7.io/status

## What a check answers
Signet7 checks whether the words in an important email still match the seal, and whether that sender is listed.
The other person checks on the website. They install nothing.
You keep the file. Nobody else can open the upload. It is checked, then deleted. Signet7 does not keep a copy.

## Words on a result
Words match: what you are reading is exactly what the sender signed.
Words do not match: the wording changed after it was signed. A forward or a mailing-list footer can do that. It is not a verdict.
No seal: ordinary email with no signature to compare against. Not an accusation by itself.
Listed: the sender's address is one Signet7 has on record for that organization.

## What is not claimed
Checking an email is free and needs no account. Checkout is not live. The company price is not published. Signet7 does not approve a payment, scan for viruses, or name the person at the keyboard. Windows and Mac. Recipients are not required to install.
